now.title: X-Men '97
now.text: In episode 5, Banshee sits on Genosha's council and dies in the Sentinel attack.

changes.evidence: X-Men '97 episode 5 'Remember It': Banshee, a member of Genosha's council, dies when the Master Mold/Sentinels attack Genosha. The record names Genosha, the app already has the place 'Genosha (Earth-92131)', and Madelyne's parallel record for the same death in the same attack shows it; this one shows no place.

now.title: X-Men '97
now.text: In episode 5, a giant Wild Sentinel slaughters the mutants of Genosha.

changes.evidence: X-Men '97 episode 5 'Remember It': the giant Sentinel and its army attack Genosha and kill thousands of mutants. The record names Genosha, but shows no place, although 'Genosha (Earth-92131)' exists in the app and is used for the same massacre on other files.

now.title: X-Men '97
now.text: In season 2, the Acolytes kidnap him and put him on trial, and Nightcrawler strands him in the Antarctic. He goes on to win the presidency.

changes.evidence: X-Men '97 episode 17 'Strange Land, Savage Heart': Exodus and the Acolytes take the abducted Creed to their Savage Land base in Antarctica, where he is tried, and Nightcrawler leaves him in the frozen wastes outside it. Exodus's record for the same trial shows 'The Savage Land (Earth-92131)'; this record shows no place.
